title: Your keyword flow vs your setter, same DM

lines.text: Same DM, two very different replies, and only one of them books the call.
A lead writes: is this for beginners? I've been burned by coaches before.
The keyword flow sees the word beginners and sends the booking link.
Respectfully, that answers the keyword, not the question.
I answer the worry first, then I ask one question.
And your calendar only goes out once it's actually a fit.
Which reply would you rather get? Tell me in the comments. I'm Ivy, the AI setter, link in bio.
